title: Portfolio Task 1 - Me and My Life
description: Extended teacher-graded speaking + writing evidence pair for the certificate. Async; both parts must be approved.
canDoStatement: Produce extended personal language as certificate evidence

writingTask.writingPrompt:
Write your MY LIFE page - like a profile page about
your whole life. 8 to 10 sentences.
Include:
- Greeting + name + age + city (T1-2)
- One family member or friend: name + description (T3-4)
- One feeling sentence (T5)
- Your home: there is/are + one preposition (T6)
- Your routine: 2 verbs + one day or time (T7-8)
- One price or number sentence (T9-10)
minimumRequirements: 8-10 sentences, all six content points present
at/on/in used at least once for time

speakingTask.speakingPrompt:
Record 60-90 seconds. This is your first BIG recording -
show everything you know!
Talk about:
1. You: name, age, city (T1-2)
2. One person: family or friend - name, what they look
like, how they are today (T3-5)
3. Your home: rooms + one thing and where it is (T6)
4. Your day: 2 things you do + when (day, time) (T7-8)
5. Food: one thing you like or order at a cafe, with
a price (T9-10)
Speak in this order - it tells your story!

Tip: Practice each part once. Do NOT read a text - talk!

teacherNotes: Source: tasilla_portfolio_task1.txt. Approval bar: 5 of 6 per part, understandability mandatory. XP 25 per part +15 on approval.

criteria.title: Speaking: Routine: verbs + time expression, -s if 3rd person used
Speaking: Food/price: like or Can I have + a number
Speaking: Understandable throughout (A1 bar: patient listener follows easily)
Writing: All six content points present
